claim: Time a hook adds to a frame-locked update can cost a whole frame on many updates; measure the slack before the next interrupt, then keep added time near zero or pad back.

evidence.text: Copier calls the 9907 limiter after row 6 (97FB); slack after 9907, p10, is 2.9-13.2 k T, so +10 ms of hook work slips 56-81 % of updates a frame; "10 ms total" is no gate.
evidence.quote: 2.9-13.2 k T, so +10 ms of hook work slips 56-81 % of updates a frame; "10 ms total" is no gate.
